Combine biomarker templates with case/control differential spec

Source: R/simulate_case_control.R
build_biomarker_spec.Rd

Wraps templates in the group-level behavior spec used by simulate_case_control_cohort(). Prevalences and intensity multipliers may be scalars (broadcast to every biomarker) or vectors of length matching nrow(templates).

Usage

build_biomarker_spec(
  templates,
  case_prevalence,
  control_prevalence,
  case_intensity_mult = 1,
  control_intensity_mult = 1
)

Arguments

templates

tibble returned by holdout_biomarkers().

case_prevalence, control_prevalence

Bernoulli probability that each biomarker appears in a case or control sample. Scalar or length-matched vector.

case_intensity_mult, control_intensity_mult

Multiplier applied to the template intensity when the biomarker fires in a case or control sample. Scalar or length-matched vector.

Value

tibble with the template columns plus case_prevalence, control_prevalence, case_intensity_mult, control_intensity_mult. Suitable for biomarkers = ... in simulate_case_control_cohort().
